item.title: Workshop: Collective Movement
item.description: An interdisciplinary workshop on how moving agents — biological and engineered — acquire, represent and act on information under uncertainty. Day 1 covers sensing and information representation; Day 2 the information–movement–decision junction; Day 3 air-surface interface swarm robotics.

item.title: Science Outreach
item.description:
I believe it incredibly important to present the findings of our research to different audiences via various formats, and the more creative the better! By actively being involved in science outreach I aim to present my research through various media and create some excitement around science.

Move.inFormation Research group FILM COMING SOON! But in the meantime here are some links to some of the projects I’ve been involved in recently.

item.title: Work with Us
item.description:
Open Position: Student Assistant (HiWi)

MoveinFormation Lab, Department of Biology & CASCB, University of Konstanz 15 October – 15 December 2026

We are looking for a student assistant to support our collective bio-logging work on avian species. Tasks include:

  1. Assembling and maintaining bio-logging field kits before and after deployment
  2. Supporting field logistics planning for our Argentina campaign
  3. Joining the team in the field in Argentina for bio-logging deployments
  4. Organising multiple bio-logging data types post field campaign

Open to undergraduate and Master’s students enrolled at the University of Konstanz.
